selected_evidence.requirement: Disable core dumps for local service-account processes
selected_evidence.summary: The persistent OpenRC policy is configured; the crash probe created zero core files, and post-reboot chrony/dhcpcd processes have soft and hard limits of zero.
Crash-probe and post-reboot markers reached /var/log/messages, with syslog healthy and continuing to record service messages.
fs.suid_dumpable=0 was applied and remained active after reboot.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 8246e99a-30a2-4404-a430-b31dcb729e1f to 0483f50e-c0f1-499b-8614-cf9193f310a3; syslog, networking, chronyd, sshd, vsock-agent, network addressing, NTP synchronization, SSH listener, logging, and policy all recovered.
All temporary crash-probe files, services, core files, and reboot logs were removed.
